About the Position

The University of Lucerne advertises 100% salaried doctoral researcher positions through its HR vacancy pages. Each advertisement specifies the faculty, the project, the supervisor, the contract conditions and the fixed closing date, so applicants should read the posting carefully before preparing documents.

OpportunityPhD Candidate / Doctoral Researcher (100%) – University of Lucerne
HostUniversity of Lucerne
LocationLucerne, Switzerland
Study LevelPhD
FundingFully Funded
StipendSalaried position (100%) per Swiss university pay scales
Application DeadlineFixed closing date stated in the vacancy advertisement on the university's HR pages
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The University of Lucerne advertises 100% salaried doctoral researcher positions through its HR vacancy pages. Each advertisement specifies the faculty, the project, the supervisor, the contract conditions and the fixed closing date, so applicants should read the posting carefully before preparing documents.

Programme Highlights

  • Employment-based Swiss doctorate with full salary
  • Small-university environment with close supervision
  • Posting-specific requirements and deadlines
  • Located in central Switzerland with strong faculty-level research groups

Who Should Apply

Master's graduates meeting the specific faculty's doctoral admission requirements as described in the vacancy.

Funding and Costs

Salaried position (100%) per Swiss university pay scales, stated in the advertisement.

Deadline and How to Apply

Open the vacancy page, verify the closing date, and submit the requested documents through the university's recruitment system. Key deadline information: Fixed closing date stated in the vacancy advertisement on the university's HR pages.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About University of Lucerne

The University of Lucerne is a Swiss university with faculties of theology, humanities and social sciences, law and economics, advertising salaried doctoral positions through its HR department.

Official website: https://www.unilu.ch

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Per vacancy advertisement - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
